message: Which of today's moves are easiest on my shoulder?

message: Mere paas sirf kettlebell hai, dumbbell row kaise karun?

raw.text: Aap One-arm dumbbell row ki jagah one-arm kettlebell row kar sakte hain: 2 sets, 8-12 reps, 75 sec rest, aur 3 reps reserve mein rakhein. Ek haath aur ghutna bench ya majboot kursi par rakhein, peeth seedhi rakhein, aur kettlebell ko handle se pakadkar kohni ko hip ki taraf kheenchein. Har side ke reps poore karke haath badlein, aur agar dard ho to ruk jaayein. Aapka kettlebell kitne kg ka hai, taaki pata chale ki 8-12 reps ke liye sahi hai ya nahi?

message: How many reps should I leave in the tank on the bird dog?

raw.text: Leave 3 reps in the tank on the bird dog. That's 2 sets of 8 to 12 reps with 75 seconds of rest between sets. If you hit 12 reps and still have 3 left, it's a sign you're ready to make it harder over time. Stop if anything hurts.
